tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rwa lugs mgon nag gi las tshogs ches zab pa lag len ma bzhugs/yā man ta ka'i las byed snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/
༄༅/ /rwa lugs mgon nag gi las tshogs ches zab pa lag len ma bzhugs/yā man ta ka'i las byed snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rwa lugs mgon nag gi las tshogs ches zab pa lag len ma bzhugs/

yā man ta ka'i las byed snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/ na mo badzra bhe ra bā ya/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa'i man ngag mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs ni 'di yin te/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bris sku'i mdun du rdo leb nag po'i maṇḍal/ rang byung gis sbags pa'i tshom bu nag po can bshams pa'am/ yang na bris sku'am maṇḍal gang rung des kyang chog /mchod pa/ gtor ma/ nang mchod rakta rnams kyang bshams/ 'jigs mdzad chen po'i bdag bskyed gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi la rdo rje brag ri gru gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du ṇi las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen gyi steng du gtso bo'i thugs ga nas hūṃ yig nag po me 'bar ba rab spros te 'khod/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ byin rlabs nus mthu rnams tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā ka la sku mdog dus kyi mun pa ltar ches gnag pa/ sbom zhing thung ba/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ gtum zhig khros pa/ 'tshams pa las 'das pa'i khrau gtum drag shul can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing 'dzings pa/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul dang*/ mi mgos brgyan pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyis nang nas mgon po ma hā ka la 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

lan gsum/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ / ji ltar khas blang dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ / drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gyi/ /gnyis su med par gshegs su gsol/ /e hye hi mahā kā la ye/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs dam tshig nyer 'ongs pa/ /bskyed pa'i dam tshig byin rlabs phyir/ /thugs rjes byon la brtan par bzhugs/ /sa ma ya taṣṭhi dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rnams spros/ dam rdzas dang mchod pa'i sprin phung bstibs te/ cha byad sna tshogs dang bcas pas bdud rts-i'i chu rgyun gyi dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa'am gshin rje gshed pos dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la ya arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma/ nang mchod/ rakta gsum yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar phyogs gcig tu byin gyis brlabs/ shā sa na lan gsum sogs kyis/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par mos te phul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum brjod cing*/ nang mchod nas gtor ma la lan gsum bzlas/ shā sa na tshar gcig brjod de/ btung ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho gsol bar bsam/ oṃ mahā kā la ya sarba duṣtan mā ra ya ma hā maṃ sa kha hī/ mahā rakta khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ rakta lan gsum bran la/ shā sa na tshar gcig brjod de/ sha khrag rus pa gnam sa gang ba zhal du btab par mos/ rab tu dgyes pas ha ha ho ho hūṃ hūṃ zhes gsung bar gyur/ de nas thod pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ shā sa na 'i mthar/ sa mā ya st+waṃ/ sa ma yā ho/ lan gsum/ dpal nag po chen po khyod kyis sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod cig / bdud rtsi dang rakta bsres pa/ gtor ma la blugs/ hūṃ ring po bdun/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ/

lan gsum/ gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' yi/ / khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig / rdo rje thugs kar gtugs la phyag tu gtad par bsam/ bdud rtsi rang gi lce thog du'ang cung zad bzhag /bstod pa/ srin gzugs ma sho lo ka gsum gyis bstod/ dpal ldan nag po chen po yis/ /bdag la dgos pa'i don thams cad/ /bsam pa bzhin du sgrub pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzod/ / bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi dang 'dra bar gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ci 'grub pa zla ste/ 'bum phrag bcu gnyis grangs bsnyen chung ngu dang*/ sum cu 'bring po dang*/ zhe brgyad chen por bzhed do/ /thun gyi gzhug tu/ ye shes mgon po'i thugs ka nas/ las mgon g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa mang por byon par bsam/ yid kyi mchod pa dang gtor ma phul la/ oṃ mahā ka la gu ṇa hri da dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa bdun dang nyer gcig sogs cung zad bzla/ yang mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros nas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas ma mo nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa bkug / yid kyi mchod/ gtor ma'i lhag ma la dmigs nas/ oṃ mahā kā li raka mo ba ling ta pū dza grihṇa ho/ kha kha khā hi khā hi ma mo srog khā hi hūṃ/ lan gsum oṃ mahā kā la rau dri du ma mo sha sha /dza dza hūṃ bhyoḥbhyoḥ zhes cung zad bzlas/ las mgon thugs kar thim/ ma mor gnas su gshegs par sam/ oṃ mahā kā la dgra bo ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i rtsa ba'i bsad sngags dang*/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum gcig tu dril ba sha sa na dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la yakṣa mahā kā la hur thum dzaḥ dgra bo dam nyams kyi mgo lus priṃ priṃ phrol phrol dra ka rakṣas phyes phyes/ dum bu dum bu/ he lam khā hi/ zhes pa drag po spu gṛ'i sngags rnams cung zad bzla'o/ / shā sa na la

'bum nas bzhi 'bum gyi bar song na legs/ sngags 'thor bu gzhan bzhi po rnams bzhi khri re bzlas nas so so'i bsnyen pa song ba'o/ /de yang 'di'i sgos kyi las sbyor byed na gal che ba yin/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i zhor la zor 'phen pa tsam byed pa la ni yi dam gyi bsnyen pa thems nas/ mgon po la yi ge bcu gnyis pa bzhi 'bum song rung ba tsam yin no/ / thun 'jog khar slar yang mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya bzod gsol rten la brtan bzhugs/ /mgron gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rwa lugs yin la/ dus rgyun gyi gtor bsngo la ni gong bzhin rdzogs pas 'grub na'ang legs mod kyi/ ma grub na bris sku dang*/ maṇḍal/ sman dang*/ rakta rnams med kyang chog /bzlas pa yang yi ge bcu gnyis cung zad tsam bzlas pa kho nas chog cing*/ mchod yon sogs kyang dngos su bsham ma thub na ting nge 'dzin gyis chog pas/ de'i tshe mchod pa byin rlabs kyang mi dgos shing*/ gtor chog gzhan dang sbrel nas byed na rjes chog la sogs pa mi dgos so/ /rwa ba'i mgon nag bya ba'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs lhad med rang de yin cing*/ sham bu can gyi sngags bzhi po de shin tu rno zhing myur ba'i phyir/ rgyud rkyang gi sgrub thabs man ngag med pa'i gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'ang yin la/ spyir ni mahā ka la 'dir ro langs chen po brgyad kyi spyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i bka' nyan thun mong ma yin pa'i gcig tu 'byung bas/ 'jigs mdzad chen po'i las tshogs sgrub pa la gal chen po'i zhu ba yin par go bar bya'o/ /'dir thog mar nye bar mkho ba la/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog chen mo gtong dus mgon po nag po'i gtor zor sde'i thung cha lag tu sbyor na/ dkyil 'khor chen mo'i phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu/

chos 'byung nag po mchu la gri gug gi 'phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol me ris bskor ba zhig bya/ dbus su nyi gdan la gri gug gam tshom bu nag po bkod/ de'i steng du stegs bu la lcags snod du 'bru nag dang*/ drag rdzas bsres pa'i gtor ma gru gsum/ khrag dang*/ ro sol gyi byug pa/ rtsa ba'i zur gsum du mi mgos mtshan pa/ yungs kar dang*/ ke tshe'i gong bu dug shing gi tsher ma rnams dug khrag gis bkrus pa ci rigs pa btsug /mtha' la drag po'i mchod gtor gyis gru gsum du bskor/ 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi bsdebs la dpal gtor dang dar nag gi ba dan btsugs pa gcig kyang bshams/ mchod gtor rnams byin rlabs chen po'i skabs su yang dmigs pa gtad/ drug cu rtsa bzhi song mtshams su slar yang byin rlabs kha gso ba'i tshul gyis mchod pa byin rlabs shig bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gong du bshad pa bzhin du bya/ yig brgya lan gsum sogs bzlas nas/ sku'i dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lor bshags/ gsung gi= thugs kyi= rtsa ba'i= yan lag= sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig 'gal 'khrul thams cad so sor bshags/ 'thol bshags phul nas tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la dngos grub kyi sdong grogs dang*/ mthu stobs thog pa med par stsal nas/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ sngon gyi las las byung ba dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad gdon byur chag la sogs pa rkyen ngan thams cad bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad skad cig nyid la 'joms shing rdul du brlag par mdzad du gsol/ sarba u pa dra ba ni ba rā ya phaṭa/ ces las la bskul ba'i gsol ba btab/

'di'i sgos kyi gtor chog yin na bar 'dir bskang ba rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa re byed dgos la/ sde thung sbyor ba'i skabs mchod 'phreng tsam gyi go chod pas/ ling ga sgrol chog grub pa'i rjes su gtor ma la ling du ma sgron zhing rakta gsar ba'ang blug nas/ dgra bgegs zhal du 'debs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ shā sa na bdun nas nyer gcig gi bar ji ltar 'os pa bzla zhing*/ gtor sngags thung ba dang*/ ma mo'i gtor sngags kyang lan bdun bdun brjod/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da gnod byed ma rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ badzra kro dha mahā ka la yaṃ sha trun tsitta kro ti dun dzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ spu gri'i sngags dang*/ kā la rau dra ི sngags rnams kyang drug cu re'am ji ltar 'os pa drag tu bzla'o/ / de nas mchod pa ni/ las gshin gyi skabs kyis bstod gsum ma la/ 'don pa bsgyur te phul/ de rjes bstod bskul ni/ hūṃ dpal ldan nag po chen po ni/ /bskal ba'i me dpung nang na bzhugs/ /mi ro'i steng nas sku byung ba/ /mdog nag thung la gsus pa che/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /dgra bgegs gdug pa myur du sgrol/ /g.yas kyi phyag gi gri gug gis/ /bstan la gnod pa'i snying rtsa mchod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi thod pa yis/ /dam nyams rnams kyi snying khrag gsol/ /mche ba'i zla tshes rab gtsigs pa/ /'jig rten ma lus za bar byed/ /spyan gsum me yi tsha tsha 'phro/ /gdug pa can rnams sreg par byed/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha khyod/ /bdud kun 'dul ba'i dmag dpon yin/ /dam nyams rnams kyi gshed ma mdzod/ /mna' zan rnams kyi srog dbugs len/ / chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma ste/ /nag po gtum po las la gshegs/ /bla ma la 'khu sems can 'tshe/ /chos 'khor 'di la sdang ba rnams/ /ma lus skad cig tsam gyis kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni rings par khug /sha khrag nang khrol ma lus pa/ /dpa' bo chen pos myur du zo/

/de lus til tsam gtubs nas kyang*/ khyod kyi zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /gal te de ltar ma byas na/ khyod nyid dam tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'das pas/ /snying khrag sa la lhung bar 'gyur/ /de bas dam tshig ma 'da' bar/ /gdug pa'i dgra 'di myur du sgrol/ / mahā kā la dgra bo'i srol la breng breng*/ rgyug rgyug /ya ya/ zhes lan gsum bskul/ de nas zor 'phen pa'i skabs/ rdo zor/ yungs zor la sogs pa'i spyi dang mthun par 'phangs nas/ gtor ma zhal bsgyur te/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sngon la 'phen dgos/ spro na spyi dang mthun par 'das dang ma byon ma'i bskul nas/ mthar rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas nas shā sa na bzla bzhin du 'phangs/ de yang dgra bgegs byad ma kha kha/ dgra bgegs byad ma khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lta bu ming spel sbyar nas so/ /tshogs dang rjes chog sogs la cho ga tshar gcig gis 'grub kyang dmigs pa'i skabs nag po chen po la 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ma chad pa gal che'o/ / bzlas pa'i man ngag ni/ lce rdo rje rtse mo gsum pa/ yas rkan zla ba ā lis mtshan pa/ mas rkan nyi ma kā lis mtshan pas/ lce'i rtsa ba'i nang du sngags sgom/ rang gi thugs ka nas snying po sogs bzlas sngags dang*/ ā li kā li dpag tu med pa byung*/ lce'i rtsa ba dang*/ ā li ka li la thim/ yang ā li kā li 'od du zhu ste lce nang gi sngags la thim pas kha dog dang 'od rgyas shing nus pa brgya 'gyur du gyur/ de nas sngags bzlas pas snying ga dang lce'i 'od kyis bskul nas/ mgon po rang dbang med par las la 'khol bar bsam/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa song nas las kyi bsnyen pa ni dur khrod dang*/ phung shul dang*/ grog mkhar bdun gyis bsres pa'i maṇḍal sa ste gru bzhir rgyar khru do/ /dpangs su khru gang yan chad ji ltar 'os pa/ de'i steng du dpangs sor bzhi tsam zlum por bskor ba/ dbus su gru gsum bang rim sum brtsegs/

ngos re la khru gang sor nyi shu pa/ srab 'thug sor gnyis pa bya/ bang rim gnyis kyang zhing sor gnyis re byed/ 'brub khung gi nang yongs su mtho gang ngo*/ /yang mthun du bskos pa kho na byed na zlum pa'i kha mtshams nas sor gnyis mar gzhal ba na/ las kyi kha khyer zhing sor gnyis/ de bzhin du kha khyer dang mchu yang mthur du je dma' je dma' 'brus/ mchu'i nang 'brub khung dngos rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed yin/ gang ltar yang rung ste 'brub khung gi nang dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ ro sol sogs sbyor bas dmar nag tu byug /rim par dang po dmar po la padma/ bar ba dkar po la 'khor lo/ 'og ma sngo skya la gri gug /zla gam gsum pa la dmar po/ phyi skor zlum po la thod 'phreng dang*/ rdo ra me ri byed/ 'brub khung nang gi gzhi la 'khor sngon po rtsibs brgyad lte ba la/ hūṃ ngam gri gug /rtsibs brgyad la mahā kā la gu ṭa hri da bkod/ gri snying bca' thabs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rtsa lags g.yon du dgra ling gzhug / dbus mar lcags phur chung ngu mtshon gang ba gcig zhugs pa lhag po yin/ gri snying ma rnyed na nag po bzhi mtshon gyis bsad pa'i snying gis kyang rung*/ ro ras la mgon po'i sku 'ol tsam bris pa cig gis snying ga de la dril nas thod par bcug /zla gam mdun ma la bzhag /dar nag gi mda' dar la phur bu btags pa g.yas su btsugs/ dgra bo'i dri ma byug pa'i gzhi las ling ga sngags kyi mtha' skor ba gcig bris la/ dgug gzhug drag tu byas la thod pa mtshan ngan gyi nang du bcug 'brub khung du bzhag /de'i steng du dam rdzas bsres shing*/ dug khrag gis byug pa'i gtor ma mtho gang ba zhig lcags snod du bcug cing stegs bu la bzhag /yang na thod pa mi 'gyur bar byas te/ shing gi grab byas pa'i steng du gtor ma bzhag /liṅga la gtor ma ma reg tsam bzhag /'brub khung gi khar dar nag ras nag sogs kyis bcad do/

/mtha' drag po'i mchod pas rgya cher bskor/ rtsa gtor rang gi sngas mgor bzhag /'dzin gtor dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jog /'phral gtor ci bde ba shin tu bzhag nas phul zin pa na spyi btab dang bcas te/ rang nyal sa'i steng thog tu 'bul ba yin/ nyams len cho ga'i rim pa ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang 'dra/ dmigs pa ni bzlas pa'i skabs su/ drag po sngags kyi 'od zer gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog ser/ dug nad me gsum dgra bo'i yul khams su 'debs pa dang*/ gtor ma'i skabs su/ dgra bgegs rnams gtor ma la thim pa yang yang bsgom/ than gzhug tu 'phral gtong*/ de ma thag bskul bya zhing dgra la rbad/ shā sa na drag tu bzla'o/ /de ltar byas pas bsnyen pa'i grangs nges can byung nas mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ gta' gtor yang 'bul/ 'grub na las thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang gtang rag tu 'phul/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ las bsnyen gyi 'phro de ka mthud na bzang zhing*/ bar du mtshams cod kyang

mi 'gal mod/ yun ring du 'gyangs nas mi rung ngo*/ /de nas ling ga bca' ba ni/ dgra bo'i sha nye rus nye'i rus pa sogs rnyed na bzang ste/ mir rnyed pa shas che/ tsher ma'i shing la rus shing bya/ ro ras sam/ gri khrag gam/ sha chen gyi khu ba'am/ tshil chen byug pa'i shog bu la sngags 'bri dug sna bsres pa'i snag tshas/ oṃ badzra krodha mahā kā la/ che ge mo go ro tsa na ku ma ri tu na dza dza/ zhes bris pa mgo bo'i thad dkar bsdams/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba la che ge mo dza ha kro dhi/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ mgrin pa'i thad kar bsdams/ khrag sna bsres pa'i snag tshas tsitta krodhaṃ sogs 'don pa spos la snying ga'i thad kar bsdams/ tsha sna bsres pas che ge mo rakta kro dhi/ zhes spos pa lte ba'i thad dkar bcings/ gu gul mi zhi/ thug po'i rmang bre rnams bsres pas che ge mo ma ra ya kro ti/ zhes pa 'dom gyi thad kar bcings/ zla'i ru shing yang bsdoms te/ rdzas sngags 'dom gyi de dang 'dra/ de rnams sbyar ba'am/ dkri ba'am/ sdom pa gang byas kyang 'dra/ de la tsha ba gsum dang*/ zag rdzas grog mkhar bdun rnams 'jims pa la bsres te ru shing la g.yogs/ gzugs brnyan dod pa snying khar bris/ ling ga 'jug pa yod pa bya/ dug dang*/ ke tshe dang*/ lan tshwa dang*/ baṃ gyis snying khrag dang*/ srin lag gi khrag rnams bsres pa'i snag tshas bris ling spyi dang mthun pa zhig 'bri/ 'di 'khor lo mi byed pa'i lugs yin 'khor lo byed na rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud bcad/ rtsibs brgyad la yi ge brgyad/ dgra bo 'di zhes pa bya ba 'di na yi ge na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsibs mchan brgyad la che ge mo kha kha sogs/ mu khyud la sha sa na'i e daṃ duṣtan ma che ge mo ni mā ra ya phaṭa/ dbus su ling ga sngags bcas/ sngags ni snying po gsum char gyis skor/ lce'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan pa cig bya/ ling ga mnan pa dang*/ spyi bo sogs la 'khor lo gal che/

mes gdung ba dang*/ thun gyis bsad pa sogs la ling ga rkyang gis cho ga gsung bar 'dug /de yang nyi lhag la g.yengs/ bgegs bskrad/ dgug gzhug / lhar dbye rnams byas/ brang thal gyi stabs tshams byas te ling ga che ge mo'i snying khar bcug / sgo yang bkag 'di dag snga ma snga ma skam gyin byas dgos te/ bsher tshab gyis la ba'am/ yi ge bsubs na nus pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / de nas ling ga la pra tshil byug / tsher ma la dug khrag byug pa/ shā sa nas bsngags pas mang po bcugs dpral ba/ snying ga/ lte ba/ yan lag bzhi rnams la mi rus kyi phur bu chung ngu de yang 'debs/ de la phyi rol tu bskyed chog dgug gzhug /lha dbye drag tu bya/ thod pa'i snod mi dgos/ 'brub khung gi nang sngar gyi bris ling gi steng du 'jog pa ste/ gnas bdun du phur bus ma btab na kha bub tu 'jog zer ba dang*/ rgyab nas phur bus 'debs zer ba sogs yod kyang*/ phur bu mdun nas 'debs shing*/ ling ga'ang gan rkyal du bzhag go /ro skras yan lag dang mgul ba bcings te/ de'i sne phur bas gtod phur byas te bzhag /de ma thag tu dgug gzhug drag po lan mang po dang*/ snying po'i mthar dgug gzhug gi sngags bcug pa mang du bzlas te/ ro g.yam mam ro gos nag po sogs kyis kha bcad do/ /de'i steng gi nam mkha' la bris sku'am/ gtor ma bzhugs su gsol/ kha khyer la rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bkod/ mtshan ngan gnyis su skam thun rlon thun bshams/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin mngon rtogs kyi gzhung bsrangs/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bsnyen sngags gnyis la che ge mo mā ra ya spel ba dang*/ de la bsad sngags kyang btags te bzla/ de rjes shā sa na drag tu bzla/ thun gnyis la'ang*/ de lta bu'i sngags drug cu'am brgya nyi shu bzla/ de nas 'brub khung kha phye la/ dgug gzhug dang lha dbye drag tu bya/ nyin mo skam thun dang*/ mtshan mo rlon thun nas ling ga la btegs cing*/

yi dam gyi sngags kyis mgo drangs te bsad sngags dang shā sa na la nan tan bskyed/ thun sngags gzhan btags kyang chog /mi bsad pa'i gri lcags la bcos pa'i phyag mtshan gyis pra tshil la ri mo dod tsam 'debs/ bsad bcad kyi dmigs pa drag po byas te/ yang 'khrub khung kha bcad de mnan par bsams/ dmigs pa la mgon po 'brub khung gi dbus su bzhugs kha khyer la mkha' 'gro srin po dpag tu med pa gnas pas dgra bgegs 'gugs 'dren bsad las byed pa'o/ /cho ga'i rim pa gzhan rnams las bsnyen gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ thun gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang ba gnad yin/ dgra dang dgra'i bla bsad pa dang*/ nags la me btang ba dang*/ mkhar bsgyail ba sogs bsgrubs pa'i rtag myur du 'ong*/ gsum pa la las la sbyor ba ni/ zhag shas shig dang 'dra ba las/ thun re bzhin ling ga gsar pa de bsgral gyin zhal du btab/ de nas rtsa ba'i ling ga yang bsgral/ 'brub khung de nyid du bud shing brtsigs te sbyin sreg gi cho gas phul/ de'i thal ba cha gsum du byas/ cha gcig drag sngags bzla bzhin du rlung so langs pa'i dus su rlung la phyar/ cha gcig chu 'khor ram mtsho gnyan po la blugs/ cha gcig sa dang bsres ling ga byas snying gar 'khor lo bcugadagug gzhug drag po byas mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan/ 'di la 'byung ba bzhi'i las tshang ste lugs gcig yin/ yang na sbyin sreg mi byed par mnan pa byed na sngar gyi ling ga de thod ngan kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug /chu mi 'chor bar bya ste sa bdag glu gnyan gyi gnas sam/ 'dre drag po gnas su mnan cing gtad do/ / de nas kyang bskul ba ni skabs der yang gong du gtad pa bzhin du zor 'phen/ las dngos ma grub kyi bar du yang yang bskul bzhin zor 'phen par bya'o/ /yang na sngar ling ga 'khor lo yod med gnyis byas/ 'khor lo yod pa mnan/ med pa bsregs/ zor 'phen pa rnams byas pas/ mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gar tshang ba yin/

rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring zla ba drug /tha mas kyang zla ba dgu la 'chug pa med gsung*/ mgon po nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rkang ni de dag yin no/ / gzhan yang spogs chog ni che ba gsum/ tshwa sna tshogs/ me tog dri mi zhim pa/ khrag rnams bsres pa'i sna tshas mgon po'i sngags dang sku 'ol spyi tsam bris/ dur khrod sol ba/ gri khrag /sha chen tshil chen cung zad bsres pa'i bag zan nam/ 'bru nag rjen btags la sku 'ol spyi tsam byas/ bris sku dang*/ yi dam gyi mgo mnan pa'i sngags kyi shog ril gnyis khung du bcug /'brub khung du bcugagu gul bdug /nang gzhug bcug pa'i bu khar rdo rje gtad de/ bsnyen sngags mgo zhabs slog pas gzir/ des kyang bsad rtags ma byung na/ bsad sngags mgo zhabs bzlog pas gzir/ bsang rtags byung na bu khar spos blug /spra tshul gyi kha bcad/ khrus gsol/ mchod gtor bskang bshags rgyas pa gal che'o/ / 'di go bab tsam yin lag len du mi 'debs/ sbar bu'i las tshogs ni thod pa la gong du bshad pa'i 'khor lo bri/ lte bar ling gzugs mi dgos/ 'khor lo bsdus pa la dbus su ming rus rtsibs la bsad pa/ mu khyud la bsnyen sngags sham bu can zer ba yod/ de'i nang du tsha ba gsum/ dug sna/ tshwa sna/ tshogs tshad/ dgra du yod kyi ming rus can ling ga sngags can bri bcug /thod pa kha sbyor yod na bzang*/ de 'brub khung du bcug la mgon po 'khor bcas thod pa'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ cho ga sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bzlas pa'i sngon du dgug gzhug bya/ thod pa'i steng du mgon po bzhugs par bsam/ sngags kyi bsham du dgra bo che ge mo nor dang bcas pa u tsi ṭa ya shi ra staṃ bha ya nan/ zhes bzla zhing*/ nyin mo yang nyung thun dang*/ mtshan mo dug thun 'debs/ ltas byung na khang sel du byed na khang pa'i rmang ngam grib ma phog sar mnan/ rigs rgyud brlag par byed na so tog sol ba bla ma rnams la sngags khri bzlas/

de dang thal bas thod pa kha sbyor gyi bar mtshams bkang ste/ dur khrod chen po'am/ gzhi bdag gnyan po gnas sar gtad par bya'o/ /gal te thod pa bam ril la sgrub pa yin na thod pa'i nang du rdzas dang 'khor lo ling ga rnams bcug la/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs nas thod pa'i gdong dgra phyogs la bstan te sba'o/ /gzhan yang me la du ba dang*/ mdzes 'dzin pa dang*/ ser ba dbab pa/ gdon gyi las te/ de rnams kyi/ rnam bzhag gzhung nas gsal lo/ /zhes pa rje btsun rwa lo'i man ngag /mgon po mahā kā la'i sgrub thabs 'di yang yi ge rnying pa'i gsal byed du gab 'khrug med cing go bde ba rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bkod pa'o// // maṅga laṃ// gcig zhus// shubhaṃ// dge'o// 'di bris dge bas skye ba kun tu nges don bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad mngon spyod drag pos bsgral nus par gyur cig /bya ba gang brtsam chos dang mthun nas kyang*/ /sdig las gang gis nyams pa med bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dri ma med pa'i legs lam la/ /skye 'dir dge rtsa 'bad tshad der 'gyur shog/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 130 -- PAGE 131 -- PAGE 117 -
